summary_md: **Jakub Hecht ([@Duncopunc](https://x.com/Duncopunc/status/2116469880954274124))** notes MCP tool definitions consumed about 52k tokens of his Claude Code context, and releases **KyttoMCP 1.0.9.1** for macOS, which shows each tool's context cost and toggles individual tools in Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity and OpenCode with undo ([release](https://github.com/heyitsjakub/KyttoMCP/releases/tag/v1.0.9.1)).
